coverImageAlt: A navy platform connects four tactile workflow modules with cyan channels and an orange keystone.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: A raised architectural platform that connects modular workflow, data, governance, and approval tiles into one stable product foundation, expressing a comprehensive requirements template for low-code internal solutions without depicting any vendor product.
Scene/backdrop: Warm-paper modelmaking table against a slate backdrop, open and uncluttered.
Subject: One dominant navy pedestal platform carrying four distinct interlocking physical tiles: a flowing channel, a bead reservoir, a guarded arch, and a stepped approval bridge; cyan connectors link them and one small orange keystone completes the platform.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail; handcrafted architectural maquette, ceramic tiles, cut paper, and restrained mechanical joinery.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; slightly low three-quarter view that emphasizes the platform silhouette; large simple modules readable at approximately 290-pixel card width; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%.
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical; controlled cyan underlighting and a sparing orange keystone.
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Materials/textures: matte ceramic, heavy paper, painted wood, frosted glass connectors, subtle grain.
Constraints: original image; one dominant metaphor; generic physical workflow components only; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling.
Avoid: recognizable low-code software screens, flowchart icons, branded cloud symbols, app logos, generic chatbot imagery, glowing brains, excessive modules, Microsoft-like gradients.
Targeted correction: Remove every surrounding document, sheet, line, groove, and mark from the backdrop; show only the complete raised platform centered inside the inner 84% of a plain warm-paper plane with a clear border on all sides, preserving the same four physical modules, cyan connectors, and orange keystone.
